title: POSIX termios/ioctl shims (tcgetattr/tcsetattr/tcflush/ioctl)
acceptance_criteria: tcsetattr(fd, when, *const Termios) → issues PTS_SET_TERMIOS_LABEL with When enum
tcflush(fd, queue) → issues PTS_FLUSH_LABEL with FlushQueue
ioctl(fd, TIOCGWINSZ/SWINSZ/GPGRP/SPGRP, arg) → issues corresponding PTS_* verbs
pts_call() generic helper for IPC call + postcard encode/decode
All #[no_mangle] pub extern "C" signatures match newlib <termios.h>
completion_summary: Impl POSIX termios/ioctl: tcgetattr (PTS_GET_TERMIOS), tcsetattr (PTS_SET_TERMIOS w/ When), tcflush (PTS_FLUSH w/ FlushQueue), _ioctl (TIOCGWINSZ/SWINSZ/GPGRP/SPGRP). pts_call! macro for postcard IPC. PtsErr→EIO/EINTR/EAGAIN/EPERM/EINVAL. 7 #[no_mangle] shims. Build unverified (no bash access).
